name: wxqt-qt
description: Qt for the packages, built by vcpkg (see .github/workflows/qt-vcpkg-trial.yml): only what wxqt uses - QtCore, QtGui, QtWidgets, QtNetwork (QT += core gui network widgets in wxqt.pro) - with the platform plugin, image formats and TLS it needs, and windeployqt on Windows. No SQL, no D-Bus, no ICU on Windows (Windows has its own), no Vulkan, no Wayland.
